environment.machine_label: AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 5850U; 8 cores / 16 logical CPUs
environment.source_hash_normalization: UTF-8 text with LF line endings
environment.isolation: Interactive local workstation; no CPU pinning, process isolation or power controls.

methodology.timed_scope: Direct scheduler.solve(): includes model construction, search and result assembly; excludes dependency import, warmups, verification, HTTP, UI and file I/O.
methodology.strategy_order: Alternated by trial, within each case.
methodology.verification: Every feasible/optimal schedule, including warmups, checked with verify_schedule; invalid output aborts the run. No latency thresholds are asserted.

cases.name: layered_20
cases.description: Deterministic layered OR graph; all courses have three credits and difficulty three; all offerings are unconstrained; the last layer is mandatory.

cases.name: layered_50
cases.description: Deterministic layered OR graph; all courses have three credits and difficulty three; all offerings are unconstrained; the last layer is mandatory.

cases.name: layered_100
cases.description: Deterministic layered OR graph; all courses have three credits and difficulty three; all offerings are unconstrained; the last layer is mandatory.

cases.name: layered_200
cases.description: Deterministic layered OR graph; all courses have three credits and difficulty three; all offerings are unconstrained; the last layer is mandatory.

cases.name: and_or_offerings
cases.description: Nested AND/OR plus Fall/Winter availability, seven-credit capacity and at most one difficult course per term; waiting terms count toward finish.

cases.name: credit_infeasible
cases.description: One mandatory twenty-credit course exceeds the sixteen-credit term cap.

cases.name: cycle_infeasible
cases.description: Two mandatory prerequisites form a cycle with no completed credit or OR escape.
